prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript module exporting `StockItem`, `Reservation`, and class `ReservationBook`. Its constructor accepts readonly stock items with unique non-empty SKUs and non-negative integer quantities; malformed or duplicate entries throw `TypeError`. `reserve(id, lines)` creates a reservation from unique SKU lines with positive integer quantities, subtracting them from available stock atomically. The non-empty reservation id must be unique; unknown SKUs or insufficient stock throw without changing any state. `commit(id)` changes an open reservation to committed and removes its quantities from the reserved totals without restoring availability. `cancel(id)` changes an open reservation to cancelled, restores availability, and removes reserved totals. Unknown ids or non-open reservations throw `Error`. `snapshot()` returns `{stock, reservations}` arrays sorted lexicographically by SKU and id respectively. Stock rows contain `sku`, `available`, and `reserved`; reservation data contains copied line objects and status `open`, `committed`, or `cancelled`. Returned data and constructor/method inputs must never alias mutable internal state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
